title: Finite product weight on coordinates
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\\delta\\in\\mathbb{R}$, and assign one of the states free, fixed to $1$, or fixed to $-1$ to each of the $n$ coordinates. The product of the coordinate weights over these coordinates equals the restriction assignment weight: each free coordinate contributes $\\delta$, and each fixed coordinate contributes $(1-\\delta)/2$.
hypotheses_covered: A restriction state is assigned to each of the $n$ coordinates
